name: DigitalVehicleHealthCheck
tagline: Multipoint inspection to sold work – red/amber/green, priced recommendations and declined-work follow-ups in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete digital vehicle health check app for dealer and independent workshops: technicians rate every checklist item with measurement-driven red/amber/green ratings, notes and photos; advisors price and present the recommendations, the customer approves or declines, and declined work becomes a follow-up pipeline. Dashboard KPIs show identified vs. sold value, conversion and sold hours per technician. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Measurement-driven ratings (tyre tread, brake pads, battery health) with configurable limits
One-tap G/A/R rating buttons sized for tablets and phones
Priced recommendations from labour hours × rate + parts
Customer presentation with approve/decline, approve all red and decision channel
Red-work decline safety acknowledgement, reason and follow-up date
Bulk approve / decline / mark done with Undo
Declined-work follow-up desk: call, book, snooze, lost
Start a health check from a configurable checklist template with VIN validation
Technician performance and VHC conversion KPIs
Demo mode, map-your-columns, read-only, disabled, empty and loading states
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSave, OnCreate, OnStatusChange, OnAction)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
